notes.title: PLDP webinar is mandatory
notes.text: INSEAD's newsletter this morning says the 5 November PLDP intro webinar is mandatory, live or by recording. The alumni meet and greet on 28 October is new, and both are on your calendar now. - Register for the PLDP one while the mail is open.
acted: Added the alumni meet and greet on 28 October and the Amazon info session on 2 November to the calendar as events.

notes.itemTitle: [NEWS] Apply to Amazon Pathways (MBA Operations LDP)
notes.title: Amazon session before you apply
notes.text: Amazon runs an internships info session on 2 November for Pathways and Launch, and they fill on a rolling basis, so the application goes in right after. It is on your calendar. - The newsletter also links open roles with early deadlines, and a J&J session on Tuesday.
